messages:
maya (product): heads up — large finserv asked for a 'telemetry recall' capability. they want to pull request traces + audit logs for specific user_ids and conversation_ids for 90 days, with a signed proof of integrity and an export SLA of 24h. also BYOK for exported bundles. need to decide scope for SOC2/ISO acceptance. thoughts?
lee (security): sounds doable but gaps: chain-of-custody, signed manifests (SHA256 or merkle), and evidence of who requested the export. BYOK for export storage ok. we need per-tenant audit trail + sealed manifests. :thinking_face:
toni (legal): legal: we need a legal-hold flag in the system (can override TTL), and export packages must include provenance metadata and retention statements we can put in contracts. we can't promise 90d for all customers without infra and pricing.
alex (sales): customer is willing to pay for a compliance add-on. they asked for timeline now. can we give a conservative commit? they'd prefer 90d + 24h SLA but could accept staged rollout.
sam (eng): high level engineering work: 1) index telemetry by tenant + user_id + convo_id 2) build export pipeline + on-demand export API 3) signed manifest generator 4) BYOK integration for export bucket. rough estimate: MVP with nightly bulk exports = ~6 wks with 2 engs; on-demand 24h SLA + perf work is +3-4 wks. will need more storage and query infra. example retention config snippet: ```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-fin",
  "retention": { "type": "sliding_window", "days": 30 },
  "legal_hold": false
}
```
jamie (customer success): could we offer 30d and 90d tiers to unblock customers while we build the 24h SLA? ops will need a runbook for manual exports in the meantime.
maya (product): propose MVP scope to align now: - 30-day recall (configurable per-tenant) - per-tenant export API (on-request) - signed manifest (SHA256 + issuer metadata) - export SLA: 48h for MVP, goal 24h for GA - BYOK for exported bundles optional (pilot) gating for launch: signed manifest + ops playbook + pilot with one customer. accept? checkbox: - [ ] 30d recall - [ ] per-tenant export API - [ ] signed manifest - [ ] 48h SLA - [ ] pilot customer
lee (security): +1 but must include requestor identity, token + IP in manifest. also retention TTL enforcement must be tamper-evident.
sam (eng): i'll own a tech design doc. owner: @sam. i'll draft PRD and rough infra cost by EOW. need two engineers for 6 wks to hit the MVP scope.
toni (legal): i'll draft export contract language and e-discovery/legal-hold wording. owner: @toni. will push a first pass by Tue.
alex (sales): i'll confirm pilot customer and budget. planning to pitch the 30d+pilot option this week.
maya (product): action items: sam (tech design + PRD), toni (legal language), jamie (ops runbook + playbook), alex (pilot + budget). target: pilot in ~8 weeks. i'll slot this into the roadmap but marking as customer-driven compliance add-on. tagging @security-team for visibility.
security-team: noted. we'll review the design when sam posts the doc and run a threat model review.
